certificate.caveat: With 90% confidence, the error rate among the 8 auto-accepted fields is at most 10%. The threshold was set on 289 labelled documents, and 40% of this batch cleared it. That promise assumes these documents resemble the calibration ones. If they don't -- a new supplier layout, a different country, a changed template -- it can silently fail, which is why 2 auto-accepted fields are randomly sampled for checking rather than trusting the certificate blindly.
